lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regularly spaced vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters, organized into roughly parallel horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank between the posterior gill margin and the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance that align with the centroids of the circular blobs, creating a grid-like matrix of high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature extending horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal margin to deep shadow on the ventral margin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance circular points visible on the remaining surface area of the primary dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major structural amputation/notch on the posterior edge of the first dorsal fin; irregular high-luminance marking on the leading dorsal edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A series of approximately 10-12 visible vertical stripes intersecting the lateral line at near 90-degree angles.
